question: A timetable shows a dentist's appointments with varying lengths: 30-minute check-up, 45-minute filling, 60-minute root canal, 20-minute consultation. If appointments start at 09:00 with this sequence, when does the root canal appointment end?
explanation: Check-up ends 09:30, filling ends 10:15, root canal ends 11:15.

question: The table shows international time zones: London 12:00, New York -5 hours, Tokyo +9 hours, Sydney +11 hours. When it is 18:30 in London, what time is it in Tokyo?
explanation: Tokyo is 9 hours ahead of London. 18:30 + 9 hours = 03:30 the next day.

question: A timetable shows a marathon with checkpoints: Start: 08:00, 10km: 09:15, 20km: 10:35, 30km: 12:10, Finish: 13:45. What was the slowest 10km section?
explanation: Start-10km: 1h 15min, 10km-20km: 1h 20min, 20km-30km: 1h 35min, 30km-Finish: 1h 35min. Slowest sections are 20-30km and 30-Finish at 1h 35min each.

question: The table shows bakery production schedule: Bread baking 04:00-06:30, Pastries 06:00-08:30, Cakes 07:30-10:00, Cookies 09:00-11:30. For how many hours do at least two items bake simultaneously?
explanation: Overlapping periods: Bread+Pastries (06:00-06:30)=30min, Pastries+Cakes (07:30-08:30)=1h, Cakes+Cookies (09:00-10:00)=1h, plus other overlaps. Total simultaneous baking is 4h 30min.

question: A timetable shows train frequency: Peak hours (07:00-09:00 & 17:00-19:00) every 8 minutes, Off-peak every 15 minutes. How many trains run during one peak hour period?
explanation: In 2 hours peak (120 minutes), trains every 8 minutes: 120 ÷ 8 = 15 trains total. Per one hour: approximately 7-8 trains. 60 ÷ 8 = 7.5, so 7 complete intervals.

question: The table shows shift patterns: Morning 06:00-14:00, Afternoon 13:30-21:30, Night 21:00-06:30. How much overlap time exists between morning and afternoon shifts?
explanation: Morning ends at 14:00, afternoon starts at 13:30. Overlap: 13:30 to 14:00 = 30 minutes.

question: A timetable shows satellite TV recordings: Program A records 20:00-21:30 on Channel 1, Program B records 20:45-22:15 on Channel 2, Program C records 21:00-22:30 on Channel 3. A system can only record 2 channels simultaneously. What is the minimum recording time lost if all programs are desired?
explanation: From 21:00-21:30, all 3 programs overlap and only 2 can record, losing 30 minutes. From 21:30-22:15, programs B and C overlap, can record both. From 22:15-22:30, only C continues. Total loss from choosing which program to skip during triple overlap: 30 minutes minimum, but other considerations yield 45 minutes.

question: The table shows prescription instructions: Take 2 tablets 3 times daily, each dose 8 hours apart, first dose at 07:00. If the prescription is for 10 days, what time will the final dose be taken?
explanation: Doses at 07:00, 15:00, 23:00 each day. On Day 10, the final dose is at 23:00.
